results.name: CSV preserves commas, quotes, CRLF, empty fields, and Unicode
Malformed or nonsequential CSV stops instead of silently dropping history
Retrieval requires three words, uses all terms, and preserves exact rows
Native tool tokens do not count as conversational tokens
Every turn retrieves then responds; only second output is speech and the next turn starts fresh
Zero matches and invalid three-word queries reach the response unchanged without repair
First-pass narration or truncation cannot become speech or trigger a blind second call
A second-pass tool call fails visibly instead of being counted as a reply or making a third call
Malformed native output remains evidence and produces no completed turn
100 synthetic replies alternate 50/50 and commit CSV before each next call
GPU seed still produces 50/50 with the seed excluded
Reload restores CSV and diagnostics without calling a model or resetting history
A failed CSV append preserves prior rows and prevents the next actor call
Diagnostic model loading waits for the start checkpoint acknowledgement
Diagnostic generation waits for durable evidence, then reports first token, progress, and cleanup
A rejected diagnostic checkpoint prevents model inference
A changed replay prompt is preserved diagnostically and never reaches inference
All three trials replay identical captured CPU input; GPU warmup speech stays outside it
Diagnostic reload exposes saved trials without a model call or a conversation write
Diagnostic disk failure sends no successful acknowledgement and stops before generation
Collector failure exports the unsaved error instead of the stale running file
Final export waits for completion while live checkpoints remain available during a stalled save
Collector failure during a turn retains the event and error without retrying inference
Worker requires isolation before either model loads and requests four threads on eight processors
Actual chat stops before CSV when saving a received result fails and restores its error marker
CSV committed before a failed JSON close is reconciled from the exact durable prepared result
Two actual controllers share one owner; the second cannot create a worker or overwrite files
Interrupted chat reload exposes saved checkpoints without restarting a model
Offline shell returns isolated document and worker, caches executable modules, and leaves weights to the runtime cache
Actual chat does not export completion while the final evidence close is stalled
Reload refuses stale completion when a clear was interrupted between the two files
GPU startup failure releases both lanes and survives actual-controller reload
